questions.question: Is a small sale with only 10 guns and 2 sellers a "gun show" under this bill?
questions.notes: No: a gun show needs twenty-five or more firearms exhibited or offered, or at least three gun show vendors.

questions.question: Who counts as a "gun show promoter"?
questions.notes: A person who organizes or operates a gun show.

questions.question: For a gun show held inside a city, who is the "point of contact agency"?
questions.notes: Either the sheriff with jurisdiction over the place, or the law enforcement agency of that municipal corporation.

questions.question: Does trading one gun for another count as a "transfer"?
questions.notes: Yes: transfer means any sale, exchange, trade, barter or other transfer.

questions.question: I'm not a licensed dealer. What has to happen before I can sell my rifle to another private person at a gun show?
questions.notes: As an unlicensed transferor, the sale must go through a federally licensed dealer or point of contact agency that gives the (C)(4)(a) all-clear notice.

questions.question: Who has to follow 18 U.S.C. 922(t) when helping with a sale at a gun show?
questions.notes: The assisting federally licensed firearms dealer or point of contact agency.

questions.question: What does the bill change in section 5122.311 of the Revised Code?
questions.notes: Incompetency records checks may be requested by dealers and point of contact agencies under 2923.27, answered immediately; adds definitions by reference to 2923.27.

questions.question: What does new division (A)(4) of section 2929.28 require?
questions.notes: A mandatory fine in the amount set by 2923.27(H)(1), (2) or (3) for a misdemeanor violation of 2923.27.

questions.question: What does the bill say about transfers approved under 26 U.S.C 5812?
questions.notes: They are exempt from division (B).

questions.question: Who are the sponsors of S. B. No. 203?
questions.notes: Senators Thomas and Lehner.

questions.question: What is the most a court can fine someone for a misdemeanor of the first degree under section 2929.28?
questions.notes: Not more than one thousand dollars (existing law).

questions.question: How much can a dealer charge to help with a background check at a gun show?
questions.notes: Not more than ten dollars per firearm transfer.

questions.question: Can kids go to a gun show?
questions.notes: Under eighteen only with a parent, guardian or custodian.

questions.question: Do guns have to be unloaded before they're brought into the show?
questions.notes: Yes: cleared of ammunition and tagged for identification.

questions.question: Can I give my grandson a gun at a gun show without a background check?
questions.notes: Yes: a bona fide gift between immediate family members (including grandchildren) is exempt from division (B).

questions.question: How big is the fine the first time someone sells a gun at a show without a background check?
questions.notes: Misdemeanor with a five thousand dollar fine.

questions.question: What sign has to be posted at the parking lot entrances?
questions.notes: That parking-area transfers must be completed the same way as inside, and other parking-area transfers are a crime.

questions.question: How quickly does the attorney general have to answer a mental-health records check from a gun dealer?
questions.notes: Immediately upon receipt of the request.

questions.question: Does the person running a gun show need permission from the sheriff?
questions.notes: Yes: a permit from the sheriff, obtained 30 to 60 days before the show.

questions.question: Can the buyer get in trouble too, or only the seller?
questions.notes: The unlicensed transferee can be charged with a misdemeanor: $250 fine, $500 for a repeat.

questions.question: Which existing sections of the Revised Code does this bill repeal?
questions.notes: Repeal language (no struck text in this bill): existing sections 2929.28 and 5122.311, replaced by the amended versions.

questions.question: Does this bill ban assault weapons?
questions.notes: Not addressed.

questions.question: Does this bill change the rules for carrying a concealed handgun?
questions.notes: Not addressed.

questions.question: How much does a hunting license cost?
questions.notes: Not addressed.
